text: Foster carer, I'll keep it to the facts. 4 year old boy, temp read 39.7 about twenty minutes ago. I think he's had a dose of paracetamol around teatime and ibuprofen since, I'd have to check the log to be exact. Between doses he's honestly been fine as far as I can tell. Playing with his cars, drinking his squash, chatting away nonstop. His colour looks normal to me, skin and lips just how they always are. I'm not sure if 39.7 is high enough that he needs seeing tonight or if it's a ride-it-out situation. I've had kids with temps before but I don't think any went this high, so I could be overthinking it. I just need a yes or no on whether to bring him in. If it's no I'll keep doing what I'm doing and keep an eye on him.
